entities.name: Jolene
entities.description: Human Riveteers demolitionist from New Capenna, the Plunder Queen, later in Thunder Junction.

entities.name: Riveteers
entities.description: Capenna crime family; Jolene is a demolitionist for them.

entities.name: Brokers
entities.description: Capenna crime family that offered Jolene legal assistance.

entities.name: Obscura
entities.description: Capenna crime family whose agent abducted Jolene.

entities.name: Thunder Junction
entities.description: Plane Jolene entered through an Omenpath.

events.summary: Jolene breaks into a jewelry shop's vault and the Brokers offer legal help in exchange for new Halo honeycomb storage.
events.quote: After she broke into a jewelry shop's vault, the Brokers offered her legal assistance

events.summary: An Obscura agent working for the Riveteers abducts Jolene and forces her to steal plans to ignite a war between the Brokers and Riveteers.
events.quote: She was abducted from her apartment by an Obscura agent working for the Riveteers

events.summary: Jolene enters Thunder Junction through an Omenpath.
events.quote: Jolene entered Thunder Junction through an Omenpath between 4562 and c. 4563 AR .

relations.quote: Jolene was a human Riveteers demolitionist in New Capenna.
